nodes.name: heroku-r2-deployment.md
nodes.summary: Heroku + Cloudflare R2 deployment plan covering 7 phases: R2 storage driver implementation, deploy artifacts, local verification, Cloudflare R2 setup, Heroku provisioning, DNS configuration for pavati.tech, and Google OAuth go-live. Includes architecture diagram, smoke test checklist, rollback strategy, and cost breakdown.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown document with embedded bash code blocks, TypeScript snippets, and an ASCII architecture diagram. Uses checkbox syntax for post-deploy smoke checklist.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Exclusion configuration for the understand analysis tool. Lists gitignore-mirrored patterns (.env files, uploads, dev.db), test file patterns for JS/TS/C#/Java/Go/C++/Python/Rust/Ruby/Swift, all currently commented out as suggestions.
nodes.languageNotes: Gitignore-syntax configuration file. All entries are commented out with # prefix, serving as template suggestions rather than active exclusions.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Understand analysis tool configuration. Sets output language to English for generated knowledge graph content.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-line JSON with one key-value pair.

nodes.name: scan-result.json
nodes.summary: Full project scan result for Pavati Pustak monorepo. Contains 132 files across 8 languages, 16 detected frameworks, workspace structure for 4 packages (@pavati/api, @pavati/web, @pavati/receipt-engine, @pavati/shared), and the complete import map with 316 edges. Estimated complexity: moderate.
nodes.languageNotes: Large JSON document (242+ lines) containing nested arrays of languages, frameworks, workspaces with modules/features, statistics, file list with metadata, and full import map.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: API server package manifest for @pavati/api v0.1.0. ESM module with Express server, Prisma ORM, AWS S3/R2 storage, Google OAuth, pdf-lib receipt generation, Zod validation, and pino logging. 20 dependencies, 12 dev dependencies. Scripts for dev/build/test/database management.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard Node.js package.json with ESM type module, workspace dependencies (@pavati/shared, @pavati/receipt-engine), and AWS SDK for R2 object storage.

nodes.name: init/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Initial database migration creating the complete PostgreSQL schema. Defines 12 enums (AuthProvider, TrustRole, MemberStatus, JoinMode, PaymentMode, DonationStatus, DonationPrivacy, ReceiptStatus, PageSize, NotificationChannel, NotificationStatus, AnnouncementType) and 16 tables (User, OtpCode, RefreshToken, Trust, TrustMember, Donor, Donation, Receipt, ReceiptTemplate, ReceiptNumberConfig, PaymentCampaign, PaymentTransaction, Announcement, AnnouncementRead, Notification, AuditLog, TrustInvite, JoinRequest) with all foreign keys, indexes, and unique constraints.
nodes.languageNotes: PostgreSQL DDL with CREATE TYPE enums, CREATE TABLE with constraints, CREATE INDEX with composite keys, and ALTER TABLE foreign key constraints. Uses TIMESTAMP(3) for millisecond precision, JSONB for flexible metadata fields, and TEXT[] array columns.

nodes.name: receipt_number_unique_per_trust/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration changing receipt number uniqueness from global to per-trust. Drops the global Receipt_receiptNumber_key unique index and creates a composite unique index on (trustId, receiptNumber), allowing different trusts to use overlapping receipt numbers.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-statement migration: DROP INDEX followed by CREATE UNIQUE INDEX with composite key.

nodes.name: drop_otp_codes/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration removing the OtpCode table. The phone-based OTP authentication flow was replaced by email/Google auth, making the OTP table obsolete.
nodes.languageNotes: Single DROP TABLE statement.

nodes.name: add_trust_qr_code_url/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding a nullable qrCodeUrl text column to the Trust table for QR code generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Single ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN statement with nullable TEXT column.

nodes.name: move_qr_to_campaign/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration moving QR code URL from Trust to PaymentCampaign table. Adds qrCodeUrl to PaymentCampaign and drops it from Trust, reflecting that QR codes are per-campaign rather than per-trust.
nodes.languageNotes: Two ALTER TABLE statements: ADD COLUMN and DROP COLUMN. Column moves from Trust to PaymentCampaign.

nodes.name: add_donation_splits/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding the DonationSplit model for mixed payment mode support. Extends PaymentMode enum with MIXED value, creates DonationSplit table with foreign keys to Donation and TrustMember (verifiedBy), adds index on donationId, and backfills one split per existing donation with verified status.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-statement migration: ALTER TYPE to extend enum, CREATE TABLE with foreign keys, CREATE INDEX, and INSERT ... SELECT backfill with gen_random_uuid() for primary keys.

nodes.name: add_donation_submitted_by/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding submittedById foreign key to Donation table, linking to TrustMember. Tracks who submitted a donation record (distinct from collector who physically received it).
nodes.languageNotes: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN with nullable TEXT, followed by ADD CONSTRAINT foreign key to TrustMember with ON DELETE SET NULL.

nodes.name: migration_lock.toml
nodes.summary: Prisma migration lock file pinning the database provider to PostgreSQL. Prevents accidentally applying migrations to a different database engine.
nodes.languageNotes: TOML format with single key-value pair. Provider value is 'postgresql'.

nodes.name: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Complete Prisma schema defining the Pavati Pustak data model. 12 enums and 18 models covering User management (User, RefreshToken), Trust organization (Trust, TrustMember, TrustInvite, JoinRequest), financial tracking (Donation, DonationSplit, Donor, PaymentCampaign, PaymentTransaction), receipt generation (Receipt, ReceiptTemplate, ReceiptNumberConfig), communication (Announcement, AnnouncementRead, Notification), and audit (AuditLog). PostgreSQL datasource with UUID primary keys, composite unique constraints, and cascade delete relationships.
nodes.languageNotes: Prisma schema DSL with generator client, datasource PostgreSQL, enum definitions with named values, model definitions with field types, relations with onDelete/onUpdate strategies, and index/unique compound constraints using @@ directives.

nodes.name: seed.ts
nodes.summary: Database seed script that clears all existing data and creates a production admin user (Pranay Pawar) with email auth and bcrypt-hashed password. Used for initial setup and development resets.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PrismaClient for database operations, bcryptjs for password hashing, and sequential deleteMany calls to clear all tables in dependency order before inserting the seed user.

nodes.name: google.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest test suite for Google OAuth authentication endpoint. Tests rejection of invalid id tokens (401) and malformed request bodies (422) when mock mode is disabled. Sets up Express app and Prisma client in beforeAll/afterAll hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses vitest (describe/it/expect), supertest for HTTP assertions, dynamic import of createApp, and process.env mutation for test configuration.

nodes.name: permissions.test.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest test suite validating the RBAC permission system from @pavati/shared. Verifies PRIMARY_ADMIN gets all permissions, COLLECTOR has limited access (create donation/receipt only), committee roles can view all donations, MEMBER/VOLUNTEER can only view own, ADMIN can manage templates, and unknown roles fall back to everyone set.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports permissionsForRole, ROLE_PERMISSIONS, ALL_PERMISSIONS from @pavati/shared. Uses describe/it blocks with toContain/not.toContain for permission set assertions.

nodes.name: schemas.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Vitest test suite for Zod validation schemas from @pavati/shared. Tests registerSchema (email normalization, disposable domain rejection, password strength), joinByCodeSchema, selfDonationSchema (amount bounds, proof URL validation), createDonationSchema (required fields, splits sum validation, awaitingPayment logic), createTemplateSchema (field configs, coordinate bounds), createTrustSchema & updateTrustSchema (custom festivals, empty list rejection, trimming), and custom categories across donation/campaign schemas.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports 8 Zod schemas from @pavati/shared. Tests use safeParse for non-throwing assertions and parse/toThrow for invalid input. Covers edge cases like empty arrays, whitespace trimming, email case normalization, and split amount arithmetic validation.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the API server. Extends root tsconfig.base.json with ESNext module, Bundler resolution, Node types, no declaration output. Compiles src and prisma directories to dist/.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON with extends, compilerOptions (outDir, rootDir, module, moduleResolution, types, declaration), and include array.

nodes.name: manifest.webmanifest
nodes.summary: PWA web app manifest for Pavati Pustak. Configures standalone display mode, saffron theme color (#f97316), cream background (#fff7ed), and a 192x192 PNG icon. Enables add-to-homescreen installation.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON-based Web App Manifest with name, short_name, description, start_url, display, background_color, theme_color, and icons array.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global CSS for the Pavati Pustak web app using Tailwind CSS v4. Defines custom theme with Indian-inspired color palette (saffron, maroon, gold, cream), custom fonts (Mukta, Noto Sans Devanagari), CSS animations (fade-in, slide-up, float), reusable component classes (card, btn variants, input, label, badge), and custom scrollbar styling. Uses @theme directive for CSS-first configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind CSS v4 with @import 'tailwindcss', @theme block for CSS-first customization (custom colors, fonts, shadows, animations with @keyframes), @layer base for html/body defaults, @utility for custom utilities, @layer components for reusable component classes, and ::selection styling.

nodes.name: tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
nodes.summary: TypeScript incremental build info cache for the web app. Contains the list of 46 root files tracked by incremental compilation and the TypeScript version (5.9.3). Auto-generated by tsc --incremental.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON file generated by TypeScript incremental compilation. Contains root file list and compiler version. Should not be manually edited.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration for the web frontend. Uses React plugin and Tailwind CSS v4 vite plugin. Dev server on port 5173 with proxy rules forwarding /api and /uploads to localhost:4000 (API server). Build target is ES2022.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Vite's defineConfig with @vitejs/plugin-react and @tailwindcss/vite plugins. Configures dev server proxy for API and uploads routes, and build target.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @pavati/receipt-engine v0.1.0. ESM module with dual exports (main entry and /server entry) with TypeScript types. Depends on @pavati/shared, pdf-lib, and @pdf-lib/fontkit for PDF receipt generation. Build script copies Mukta font files to dist/.
nodes.languageNotes: Package.json with exports map providing types and import paths for both main and /server entry points. Build script chains tsc with font copy.

nodes.name: copy-fonts.mjs
nodes.summary: Build script that copies 4 Mukta font files (Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold) from src/fonts/ to dist/fonts/. Uses Node.js fs/path modules, creates output directory if missing, and exits with error if any source font is absent.
nodes.languageNotes: ESM JavaScript using node:fs (copyFileSync, mkdirSync, existsSync), node:path (dirname, join), and node:url (fileURLToPath) for __dirname equivalent in ESM.
